prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, high-contrast low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette, physically textured surfaces, strong silhouette legible at 200 pixels. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity, erotic scene or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon lines, energy ribbons, floating runes, or unsupported anatomy.
ANATOMY: A succubus in documented adult woman with an APPENDED SERPENT TAIL variant. One human adult woman's head, two eyes, TWO human arms/hands, TWO human legs hidden under FULL LENGTH opaque high-neck long-sleeved dark walnut gown; ONE long scaly serpent tail emerges plausibly behind her hips and coils prominently around the foreground bedpost, tail has no separate head. She remains a woman with a tail deformity, not a naga replacing all legs. No horns, wings, exposed chest, lingerie or extra limbs. [succubus-c07] MOMENT: Lean from the deep shadow beside an empty bed toward the low viewer, one hand clamps the bedpost while the other draws heavy cloth aside to reveal the long snake tail moving toward foreground. Face intent and threatening, not romantic. POWER: nightmare appearance only, no invented glowing drains or energy; perspective communicates sleep-paralysis dread. [succubus-c01/c04] SCALE & CAMERA: confronting three-quarter half-body diagonal portrait, face in upper left and enormous curling tail shape fills lower right, clearly distinct composition from a bird-foot doorway crouch. LIGHT & WEATHER: one moonbeam from narrow shutter, deep shadow, dark gold rim on scales. SURFACE: coarse worn modest gown, rough wood, wetly textured serpentine tail. SETTING: editorial European sleeping chamber seen as a nightmare, empty linen-covered bed peripheral. [succubus-c01] MOOD: uncanny predatory demon presence, strictly nonsexual, no contact with people.

visual_requirements.description: Adult human woman with bird-like claws in A; adult human woman with appended serpent tail in B. No invented horns or wings, all opaque clothing.
Appears within a nightmare/sleep-paralysis context; no physical magic emission invented.
Editorial dim European sleeping chamber presents documented dream visitation without sexual contact.

selection_reason: Retained serpent-tail alternative: strong foreground tail but human lower limbs hidden by garment.

visual_review.notes: Native viewed: clothed adult woman leans toward viewer beside empty bed, one hand grips wooden bedpost and other gathers gown. A single huge scaly serpentine tail arcs from behind hip across near foreground and coils around bedpost; no separate tail head, horns or wings. Human legs remain hidden under long opaque skirt; no sexual scene, text, gore or magical aura.
limitations: Human legs entirely hidden beneath gown; tail shown as an appendage emerging behind hip, not an asserted leg-replacing naga body.
Tail proportions and dress/room details are editorial.
